spec.title: Скорости изменения теплового потока ДТП
spec.description: Heat flux speed panel uses per-channel latest samples and the selected rate interval.

spec.rawSql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT make_interval(secs => ${Rate_Interval:raw}::int) AS dt
), channels AS (
  SELECT generate_series(33, 48) AS global_channel
), points AS (
  SELECT
    ch.global_channel,
    latest.sensor_name,
    latest.avg_time AS latest_time,
    latest.avg_temperature AS latest_temperature,
    latest.measurements_count AS latest_measurements_count,
    previous.avg_time AS previous_time,
    previous.avg_temperature AS previous_temperature,
    previous.measurements_count AS previous_measurements_count
  FROM channels ch
  CROSS JOIN params p
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(NULLIF(max(sample.sensor_name), ''), concat('Sensor ', ch.global_channel)) AS sensor_name,
      to_timestamp(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM sample."time"))) AS avg_time,
      avg(sample.temperature) AS avg_temperature,
      count(*) AS measurements_count
    FROM (
      SELECT sm."time", sm.temperature, sm.sensor_name
      FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
      WHERE sm.global_channel = ch.global_channel
        AND sm.sensor_used = true
        AND sm.valid = true
        AND sm.sensor_kind_code = 2
        AND sm.temperature IS NOT NULL
        AND $__timeFilter(sm."time")
      ORDER BY sm."time" DESC
      LIMIT 5
    ) sample
  ) latest ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      to_timestamp(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM sample."time"))) AS avg_time,
      avg(sample.temperature) AS avg_temperature,
      count(*) AS measurements_count
    FROM (
      SELECT sm."time", sm.temperature
      FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
      WHERE sm.global_channel = ch.global_channel
        AND sm.sensor_used = true
        AND sm.valid = true
        AND sm.sensor_kind_code = 2
        AND sm.temperature IS NOT NULL
        AND sm."time" <= now() - p.dt
      ORDER BY sm."time" DESC
      LIMIT 5
    ) sample
  ) previous ON true
)
SELECT
  concat(global_channel, ' - ', sensor_name) AS "metric",
  ROUND(
    (
      (latest_temperature - previous_temperature)
      / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (latest_time - previous_time)), 0)
    )::numeric,
    3
  ) AS "value"
FROM points
WHERE latest_measurements_count = 5
  AND previous_measurements_count = 5
  AND latest_time > previous_time
ORDER BY global_channel;

WITH save_graph AS (
    INSERT INTO public.grafana_variable_state (dashboard_uid, graph_1, updated_at)
    VALUES ('dtp-speeds', ${Graph_1}::integer, now())
    ON CONFLICT (dashboard_uid) DO UPDATE
    SET graph_1 = EXCLUDED.graph_1, updated_at = now()
    RETURNING graph_1
), params AS (
    SELECT make_interval(secs => ${Rate_Interval:raw}::int) AS dt
), samples AS (
    SELECT sm."time"
    FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
    WHERE
        sm.global_channel = ${Graph_1}
        AND sm.sensor_used = true
        AND sm.valid = true
        AND sm.sensor_kind_code = 2
        AND sm.temperature IS NOT NULL
        AND $__timeFilter(sm."time")
), speed AS (
    SELECT
        s."time",
        latest.avg_time AS latest_time,
        latest.avg_temperature AS latest_temperature,
        latest.measurements_count AS latest_measurements_count,
        previous.avg_time AS previous_time,
        previous.avg_temperature AS previous_temperature,
        previous.measurements_count AS previous_measurements_count
    FROM samples s
    CROSS JOIN params p
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            to_timestamp(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM sample."time"))) AS avg_time,
            avg(sample.temperature) AS avg_temperature,
            count(*) AS measurements_count
        FROM (
            SELECT sm."time", sm.temperature
            FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
            WHERE sm.global_channel = ${Graph_1}
              AND sm.sensor_used = true
              AND sm.valid = true
              AND sm.sensor_kind_code = 2
              AND sm.temperature IS NOT NULL
              AND sm."time" <= s."time"
            ORDER BY sm."time" DESC
            LIMIT 5
        ) sample
    ) latest ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            to_timestamp(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM sample."time"))) AS avg_time,
            avg(sample.temperature) AS avg_temperature,
            count(*) AS measurements_count
        FROM (
            SELECT sm."time", sm.temperature
            FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
            WHERE sm.global_channel = ${Graph_1}
              AND sm.sensor_used = true
              AND sm.valid = true
              AND sm.sensor_kind_code = 2
              AND sm.temperature IS NOT NULL
              AND sm."time" <= s."time" - p.dt
            ORDER BY sm."time" DESC
            LIMIT 5
        ) sample
    ) previous ON true
)
SELECT
    "time",
    ROUND(
        (
            (latest_temperature - previous_temperature)
            / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (latest_time - previous_time)), 0)
        )::numeric,
        3
    ) AS value,
    'Скорость, Вт/м²с' AS metric
FROM speed
WHERE latest_measurements_count = 5
  AND previous_measurements_count = 5
  AND latest_time > previous_time
ORDER BY "time";

WITH save_graph AS (

WITH choices AS (
  SELECT
    concat(gs.global_channel, ' - ', latest.sensor_name) AS __text,
    gs.global_channel AS __value
  FROM generate_series(33, 48) AS gs(global_channel)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(sm.sensor_name, ''), concat('Датчик ', gs.global_channel)) AS sensor_name
    FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
    WHERE sm.sensor_used = true
      AND sm.sensor_kind_code = 2
      AND sm.global_channel = gs.global_channel
    ORDER BY sm."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) latest
), last_selected AS (
  SELECT graph_1 AS value
  FROM public.grafana_variable_state
  WHERE dashboard_uid = 'dtp-speeds'
)
SELECT __text, __value
FROM choices
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN __value = COALESCE((SELECT value FROM last_selected), 33) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  __value;
